what: The rt state immediately BEFORE the 181-card fused split, and the state after it.
why_this_file_exists: The full snapshot is before_rt_prerun.csv, which .gitignore keeps out of the repo (migrations/*/before*.csv, deliberate). A clone therefore has this fingerprint and NOT the per-card rows. That is the honest limit of what is committed.
provenance: The matview had not been refreshed since 19:27:02 on 2026-09-26, which was the canary-rollback verification refresh, and the run started at 21:42. So player_card_mv was still HOLDING the pre-run state and was dumped from it. It was captured on 2026-09-27, hours after the run, and the next refresh destroys it.

after.source: player_card_view, computed on read 2026-09-26 after the run

how_to_use_it: After `node scripts/fused-run.js --rollback`, the md5 over player_card_view must return to the BEFORE value. That is the aggregate check; the per-card before-captures in before/ are the stronger one, and the canary proved the column-for-column form.
caveat: md5 covers card_id and rt only. A column that moves while rt holds still is invisible to it, which is the shape the assists repair took.
